compiled_state.title: merge-to-main.sh: push to worktree-** session branch in non-sprint ci-pr -> rejected by Sub-PR Review Enforcement ruleset, no PR created
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** d2f53ff8cc048af0f6d6c732d97134738c4c6916
* Branch: worktree-20260528-201844 (session worktree); dso.workflow=ci-pr; not a sprint (no .sprint-active marker).
* Repo rulesets present: "DSO CI Enforcement" (branch), "DSO Sub-PR Review Enforcement" (branch).

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

A /dso:fix-bug (non-sprint) session running in dso.workflow=ci-pr that commits a fix to the session worktree branch and runs `.claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh` should be able to create a PR to main (rule:no-direct-gh-pr mandates routing through merge-to-main.sh).

#### Actual Behavior

merge-to-main.sh ran all pre-push gates (passed), created a version-bump commit (v1.17.99), then attempted `git push -u origin worktree-20260528-201844` which was rejected by GitHub:

```
remote: error: GH013: Repository rule violations found for refs/heads/worktree-20260528-201844.
remote: - Required status check "review-sub-pr" is expected.
 ! [remote rejected]       worktree-20260528-201844 -> worktree-20260528-201844 (push declined due to repository rule violations)
error: failed to push some refs
ERROR: git push -u origin worktree-20260528-201844 failed (after fetch+rebase retry)
CONFLICT_DATA {"branch": "worktree-20260528-201844", "base_branch": "main", "conflicted_files": [], "resolution_strategy": "pr-create-failed"}
```

No PR to main was created. The "DSO Sub-PR Review Enforcement" ruleset requires the `review-sub-pr` status check on worktree-** branches; that check is produced by per-task sub-PRs in the sprint flow (review-sub-pr.yml). A direct push to the session branch from a non-sprint fix-bug session has no such check, so the ruleset blocks the push and merge-to-main cannot open the session->main PR.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* merge-to-main.sh (plugin script) + the GitHub "DSO Sub-PR Review Enforcement" ruleset interaction.
* Observed workaround candidate (not yet applied): open the PR from a non-worktree-** branch (e.g. fix/*) which is not covered by the Sub-PR ruleset. fix-bug's commit path puts work directly on the session branch, which is the trigger.
